recommendation: Fielded BM25F with exact+split identifiers, lightweight positional reranking, evidence-gated feedback, and safe block-max pruning only after profiling.

papers.title: The Probabilistic Relevance Framework: BM25 and Beyond
papers.establishes: BM25 saturation/length normalization; BM25F combines normalized weighted field evidence before saturation. Blind feedback can improve averages but fail on initially difficult queries.
papers.limitation: Author monograph, not local code benchmark; semantic non-overlap remains unresolved.

papers.title: A Markov Random Field Model for Term Dependencies
papers.establishes: Term, ordered phrase and unordered window features improve tested newswire/web retrieval; sequential dependency approximates full dependence with fewer features.
papers.limitation: Original empirical corpus differs from code; proximity positional index costs and parameter tuning required.

papers.title: Efficient Query Evaluation using a Two-Level Retrieval Process
papers.establishes: WAND uses inexpensive candidate selection and exact full evaluation, reducing full evaluations by more than 90 percent in original TREC Web Track study with almost no quality loss.
papers.limitation: Reduction in full evaluations is not the same as wall-clock speedup; safe and approximate threshold settings must be distinguished.

papers.title: Faster Top-k Document Retrieval Using Block-Max Indexes
papers.establishes: Block-wise maxima allow safe pruning preserving exhaustive top-k; tested on 25.2M GOV2 documents with in-memory index.
papers.limitation: Does not establish gains on small changing repos. Impact sorting may worsen compression, scoring bounds must remain valid after score/index updates.

proposed_combination: Task-local feedback over fielded lexical candidates; derive expansion only from agent-confirmed useful passages and keep original results. This is a proposed design combination, not a verified new algorithm or a novelty claim.

controls: compare BMW with exhaustive scoring for exact result parity

confidence: High for theoretical mechanisms; medium for local-repo engineering prioritization; empirical benefit in target repository unverified.
